tools.name: alert_settings_add-an
tools.description: Adds an alert setting. Prerequisites: * Pro or a higher account with Zoom Phone license * Account owner or admin permissions Scopes: `phone:write:admin` Granular Scopes: `phone:write:alert_setting:admin` Rate Limit Label: `LIGHT`. Required: alert_setting_name, module, rule, rule_conditions, target_type, time_frame_from, time_frame_to, time_frame_type. Optional: chat_channels, email_recipients, frequency (plus 2 more). Returns the new AlertSettingsAddAnResponse.

params.name: alert_setting_name
params.description: The name of the alert setting.

params.name: chat_channels
params.description: The chat channels. It's used When the value of `module` represents `Call Queue Management`, `Route Group Management`, `Devices & Phones Management`, and `Call Quality Management`. The number of the chat channels is up to `3`

params.name: email_recipients
params.description: The email addresses of recipients. The number of the emails is up to `10`

params.name: frequency
params.description: The frequency of alert triggers. The unit is `minutes`. When the value of `module` represents `Call Queue Management` or `Route Group Management` or `Devices & Phones Management` or `Call Quality Management`, it will be used.

params.name: module
params.description: The module of the alert. The module and its code mappings are shown as: `Call Queue Management`-`1`, `Route Group Management`-`2`, `Devices & Phones Management`-`3`, `Call Quality Management`-`4`, and `Emergency Services Management`-`5`

params.name: rule
params.description: The rule of the alert. The rule and its code mappings are shown as: `Service Level`-`1`, `Inbound Abandoned Calls`-`2`, `Inbound Overflowed Calls`-`3`, `Inbound Avg Call Waiting Time`-`4`, `Inbound Forwarded to Voicemail`-`5`, `Number of Waiting Calls`-`6`, `Member Availability (Active)`-`7`, `Member Availability (Opt-in/Opt-out)`-`8`, `Route groups status change`-`9`, `Devices go offline`-`10`, `Devices go online`-`11`, `Device offline rate`-`12`, `QoS Alert`-`13`, and `Emergency Call Alert`-`14`. When the value of the `module` is `1`, the value of `rule` can only be in the range of `1` to `8`. When the value of the `module` is `2`, the value of `rule` can only be `9`. When the value of the `module` is `3`, the value of `rule` can only be in the range of `10` to `12`. When the value of the `module` is `4`, the value of `rule` can only be `13`. When the value of the `module` is `5`, the value of `rule` can only be `14`. Alerts of rule `7` or rule `8` cannot exceed 30 in number.

params.name: rule_conditions
params.description: The rule conditions.

params.name: status
params.description: The alert's status: * `0` — Inactive. * `1` — Active.

params.name: target_ids
params.description: The target IDs of the alert. The target type can be `User`, `Account`, `Call Queue`, `Site`, and `Device`. When the value of `rule` is in the range of `1` to `8`, it only supports the `Call Queue` and if the number of `Call Queue` is `1`, you should pass the `Extension ID` of the specific call queue. When the value of the `rule` is `9`, it can only support the `Account`. You only need to specify the value of `target_type`. This field doesn't need a specified value. When the value of the `rule` is `10`, it can support the `Account` or `Device`. If you want to set the `Account`, you only need to specify the value of `target_type`. This field doesn't need a specified value. If you want to set the `Device`, you should pass the `Device ID` of the specific device. The number of `Device` is up to `5`. When the value of the `rule` is `11`, it can support the `Device`. The number of `Device` is up to `5`. You should pass the `Device ID` of the specific device. When the value of the `rule` is `12`, it can support the `Site` and the number of `Site` is `1`. You should pass the `Site ID` of the specific site. When the value of the `rule` is `13`, it can support the `User` and the number of `User` is up to `5`. You should pass the `Extension ID` of the specific user. When the value of the `rule` is `14`, it can support the `Site` and the number of `Site` is `1`. You should pass the `Site ID` of the specific site.

params.name: target_type
params.description: The target type. * `1`-`User` * `2`-`Account` * `3`-`Call Queue` * `4`-`Site` * `5`-`Device`

params.name: time_frame_from
params.description: The start time of time frame in which the alert was triggered, in `HH:mm:ss` format. When the `time_frame_type` is `all_day`, the value is `00:00:00`. The value should be either at the whole hour or at half past the hour.

params.name: time_frame_to
params.description: The end time of time frame in which the alert was triggered, in `HH:mm:ss` format. When the `time_frame_type` is `all_day`, the value is `00:00:00`. The value should be either at the whole hour or at half past the hour.

Required: autoReceptionistId, hourType (default: business_hours). Optional: break_hour_id, call_handling_setting, greeting_setting (plus 1 more). Partial update.

params.name: autoReceptionistId
params.description: The auto receptionist ID.

params.name: hourType
params.description: The hour type of the call handling setting. The `closed_hours` and `break_hours` cannot be updated when business hours are set to `24 Hours a Day, 7 Days a Week`.

params.name: break_hour_id
params.description: The break hour ID. Required when `hourType` is `break_hours`.

params.name: call-handling-setting-routing-action
params.description: The action to take for incoming calls during the specified hour type: * `forward_to_voicemail` — Forward to the voicemail of an internal extension (the current auto receptionist by default, or another user, auto receptionist, call queue, or shared line group). * `play_message_then_disconnect` — Play a message and then disconnect. * `forward_to_extension` — Forward to another internal extension. The target extension type is identified by the supplied `forward_to_extension.extension_id`. * `forward_to_ivr` — Route the call to the auto receptionist's IVR menu. The IVR menu is managed via a separate API. * `forward_to_partner_contact_center` — Forward to a partner contact center. * `forward_to_external_number` — Forward to an external phone number. * `forward_to_external_contact` — Forward to an external contact. * `forward_to_zoom_contact_center` — Forward to a Zoom Contact Center voice flow. * `forward_to_voicemail_access` — Route the call to voicemail access so callers can check messages. * `forward_to_teams` — Forward to a Microsoft Teams resource account. Only allowed when the account has Zoom Phone for Microsoft Teams enabled.

params.name: call-handling-setting-routing-action-setting
params.description: The call handling setting based on the `routing_action` value. Required when `routing_action` is `forward_to_voicemail`, `play_message_then_disconnect`, `forward_to_extension`, `forward_to_partner_contact_center`, `forward_to_external_number`, `forward_to_external_contact`, `forward_to_zoom_contact_center`, or `forward_to_teams`. Omit when `routing_action` is `forward_to_ivr` or `forward_to_voicemail_access`.

params.name: greeting-setting-greeting-prompt-audio-id
params.description: The audio prompt file ID. Options: * Empty string — Default * `disable` — Disable

params.name: greeting-setting-greeting-prompt-audio-name
params.description: The audio prompt file name.

params.name: holiday_hour_id
params.description: The holiday hour ID. Required when `hourType` is `holiday_hours`.

tools.name: auto_receptionists_update-ivr
tools.description: Updates the interactive voice response (IVR) system of the specified auto receptionist. Prerequisites: * A Business or Enterprise account * A Zoom Phone license Scopes: `phone:write:admin` Granular Scopes: `phone:update:auto_receptionist_ivr:admin` Rate Limit Label: `LIGHT`. Required: autoReceptionistId. Optional: allow_callers_to_navigate_ivr, allow_dialing_by_extension (default: true), audio_prompt_id (plus 5 more). Partial update.

params.name: autoReceptionistId
params.description: The auto receptionist ID.

params.name: allow-callers-to-navigate-ivr-enable
params.description: Whether callers are allowed to navigate the IVR menu by voice in addition to DTMF keypad input. When `true`, the Zoom Phone IVR engine performs speech-to-intent matching against the configured key actions and routes the call accordingly.

params.name: allow-callers-to-navigate-ivr-voice-input-confidence-score
params.description: The minimum speech-recognition confidence threshold required to accept a voice input as a valid IVR selection.

params.name: allow_dialing_by_extension
params.description: Whether to allow callers to dial an extension to reach users, common areas, call queues, auto receptionists, and shared line groups on this account.

params.name: audio_prompt_id
params.description: The audio prompt's file ID.

params.name: break_id
params.description: The auto receptionist break hours ID. Required when `hours_type` is `break_hours`. If `holiday_id` is also passed, `holiday_id` takes precedence

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-action
params.description: The action when a caller enters no action after the prompt played. `-1` Disconnect the call `2` Forward to the user `4` Forward to the common area `5` Forward to Cisco/Polycom Room `6` Forward to the auto receptionist `7` Forward to the call queue `8` Forward to the shared line group `9` Forward to external contacts `10` Forward to a phone number `12` Play a message, then disconnect `15` Forward to the partner contact center `18` Forward to Microsoft Teams Resource Account. Required the license of Zoom Phone for Microsoft Teams. `19` Forward to the Zoom Contact Center voice flow. Required Zoom Contact Center license. `24` Forward to the ZVA(Zoom Virtual Agent) Receptionist `25` Forward to the Third-party agent

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-audio-prompt-repeat
params.description: The number of times to repeat the audio prompt.

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-caller-no-input-timeout
params.description: The number of seconds to wait for the caller's input (DTMF keypad or voice) after the prompt plays before the IVR takes the no-action `action`. Applies only when `allow_callers_to_navigate_ivr.enable` is `true`; otherwise this value is ignored.

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-forward-to-external-contact-id
params.description: The ID of the external contact to forward to. Required when `action` is `9` (Forward to external contacts).

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-forward-to-partner-contact-center-id
params.description: The ID of the Partner Contact Center to forward to. Required when `action` is `15` (Forward to a Partner Contact Center).

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-forward-to-phone-number
params.description: The phone number or external number, in E.164 format. * When `action` is `10` (Forward to Phone number/External number), this is the destination number. * When `action` is `19` (Forward to the Zoom Contact Center voice flow), this is the Zoom Contact Center number.

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-forward-to-teams-app-id
params.description: The ID of the Microsoft Teams Voice App to forward to. Required when `action` is `18` (Forward to Microsoft Teams Resource Account).

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-forward-to-third-party-agent-id
params.description: The ID of the Third-party agent to forward to. Required when `action` is `25` (Forward to the Third-party agent).

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-forward-to-zva-receptionist-id
params.description: The ID of the ZVA(Zoom Virtual Agent) Receptionist to forward to. Required when `action` is `24` (Forward to the ZVA Receptionist).

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-forward-to-extension-id
params.description: The extension ID or partner contact center setting ID.

params.name: caller-enters-no-action-voicemail-greeting-id
params.description: The voicemail greeting's file ID. Only takes effect when `action` is `12` (Play a message, then disconnect).

params.name: holiday_id
params.description: The auto receptionist holiday hours ID. If both `holiday_id` and `hours_type` are passed, `holiday_id` has the highest priority and `hours_type` is ignored.

params.name: hours_type
params.description: The type of hours.

params.name: key-action-action
params.description: The action after clicking the key. For all keys (`0`-`9`, * or #) `100` Leave voicemail to the current extension `200` Leave voicemail to the user `300` Leave voicemail to the auto receptionist `400` Leave voicemail to the call queue `500` Leave voicemail to the shared line group `2` Forward to the user `3` Forward to Zoom Room `4` Forward to the common area `5` Forward to Cisco/Polycom Room `6` Forward to the auto receptionist `7` Forward to the call queue `8` Forward to the shared line group `9` Forward to external contacts `10` Forward to a phone number `12` Play a message, then disconnect `15` Forward to the partner contact center `16` Forward to the meeting service `17` Forward to the meeting service number `18` Forward to Microsoft Teams Resource Account. Required the license of Zoom Phone for Microsoft Teams. `19` Forward to the zoom contact center voice flow. Required Zoom Contact Center license. `24` Forward to the ZVA(Zoom Virtual Agent) Receptionist `25` Forward to the Third-party agent `27` Play a message, then repeat menu greeting `28` Play a message, then return to root menu `29` Play a message, then return to previous menu `-1` Disabled For key `0`-`9` only: `26` Dial by Name Note: The value of `action = 26` (`Dial by Name`) is available only when Dial by Name Directory is enabled. For multi-site accounts, this is checked at the site level via Get a phone site setting with `settingType=dial_by_name`; otherwise, it follows the account-level setting. For key * or # only: `21` Repeat menu greeting `22` Return to the root menu `23` Return to the previous menu

params.name: key-action-key
params.description: The key. It supports the following values: numeric('0'-'9'), *, #.

params.name: key-action-target-extension-id
params.description: The extension ID or partner contact center setting ID.

params.name: key-action-target-external-contact-id
params.description: The ID of the external contact to forward to. Required when `action` is `9` (Forward to external contacts).

params.name: key-action-target-partner-contact-center-id
params.description: The ID of the Partner Contact Center to forward to. Required when `action` is `15` (Forward to a Partner Contact Center).

params.name: key-action-target-phone-number
params.description: The phone number or external number, in E.164 format. * When `action` is `10` (Forward to Phone number/External number), this is the destination number. * When `action` is `19` (Forward to the Zoom Contact Center voice flow), this is the Zoom Contact Center number.

params.name: key-action-target-teams-app-id
params.description: The ID of the Microsoft Teams Voice App to forward to. Required when `action` is `18` (Forward to Microsoft Teams Resource Account).

params.name: key-action-target-third-party-agent-id
params.description: The ID of the Third-party agent to forward to. Required when `action` is `25` (Forward to the Third-party agent).

params.name: key-action-target-zva-receptionist-id
params.description: The ID of the ZVA(Zoom Virtual Agent) Receptionist to forward to. Required when `action` is `24` (Forward to the ZVA Receptionist).

params.name: key-action-voicemail-greeting-id
params.description: The voicemail greeting's file ID. Only takes effect when `action` is one of the following: `100` Leave voicemail to the current extension `200` Leave voicemail to the user `300` Leave voicemail to the auto receptionist `400` Leave voicemail to the call queue `500` Leave voicemail to the shared line group `12` Play a message, then disconnect `27` Play a message, then repeat menu greeting `28` Play a message, then return to root menu `29` Play a message, then return to previous menu

tools.name: locations_add
tools.description: Adds an emergency service location. Prerequisites * Pro or a higher account with Zoom Phone license * Account owner or admin permissions Scopes: `phone:write:admin` Granular Scopes: `phone:write:emergency_location:admin` Rate Limit Label: `LIGHT`. Required: emergency_address_id, name. Optional: bssid, elin_phone_number_id, minimum_match_criteria (plus 8 more). Returns the new LocationsAddResponse.

params.name: bssid
params.description: A comma-separated list of the emergency service location's BSSIDs (Basic Service Set Identifiers).

params.name: elin_phone_number_id
params.description: The ELIN (Emergency Location Identification Number). This value must be a phone number ID or phone number in E.164 format.

params.name: emergency_address_id
params.description: The emergency location address ID.

params.name: minimum_match_criteria
params.description: If true, it requires a user's location match on both public and private IP address, or BSSID, or network switch; detecting only a public IP address is not enough to detect the location.

params.name: name
params.description: The emergency service location's name.

params.name: network_switches
params.description: The list of network switch bindings to locate phones at this emergency service location. When a Zoom device registers on a switch/port covered by one of these bindings, its physical location is reported as this location. For example, for E911 dispatch. This field is optional. Omit it, or pass an empty array, to create the location without any switch bindings. You can add bindings later via the switch management APIs. Limits - Up to 1000 bindings per request. - Up to 500 bindings may share the same `mac_address`. - The total number of bindings across all locations in your account is capped by your account-level quota. Uniqueness - Two entries with the same values on all five fields are rejected as duplicates. Overlap across locations (same site) - Bindings with different `mac_address` values never conflict. - Two bindings on the same `mac_address` conflict only when they both cover the same physical port. For example, `port: '11'` conflicts with `port_range_from: '10'`, `port_range_to: '20'`; two numeric ranges conflict when their intervals overlap; two prefixed ranges conflict when the prefixes are identical and the intervals overlap; a numeric range and a prefixed range never conflict because they describe different port-naming schemes. - An 'all ports' binding (all port fields empty) conflicts only with another 'all ports' binding on the same MAC — it does not conflict with specific single/range bindings on the same MAC.

params.name: parent_location_id
params.description: The parent location's ID to assign to the emergency service location.

params.name: private_ip
params.description: A comma-separated list of the emergency service location's subnet or private IP addresses. This field is required if `minimum_match_criteria` is true.

params.name: private_ipv6
params.description: A comma-separated list of the emergency service location's private IPv6 addresses. * IPv6 location support must be enabled for the account. * Each value must be an IPv6 address or an IPv6 CIDR block with a prefix length from `/112` through `/128`. * The top-level location must have at least one `public_ipv6` value before a top-level or sublocation can use `private_ipv6`. * If `minimum_match_criteria` is `true` and the location uses public IPv6, `private_ipv6` is must required. * If omitted, the existing private IPv6 values are not changed.

params.name: public_ip
params.description: A comma-separated list of the emergency service location's public IP addresses. This parameter is required for top locations.

params.name: public_ipv6
params.description: A comma-separated list of the emergency service location's public IPv6 addresses. * IPv6 location support must be enabled for the account. * Each value must be an IPv6 address or an IPv6 CIDR block with a prefix length from `/112` through `/128`. * Only top-level locations can use this field; sublocations must omit it. * A top-level location must have at least one `public_ip` or `public_ipv6` value. * If omitted, the existing public IPv6 values are not changed. * An empty value cannot remove all public IPv6 addresses from a top-level location that currently has public IPv6 addresses.

params.name: sip_group_id
params.description: The SIP group ID to assign to the emergency service location. This value is not required for non-top locations.

params.name: site_id
params.description: The site ID.

params.description: Whether the PTT channel is auto-connected. Multiple auto-connect PTT channels can coexist in the same site or account. For broadcast channels, this value is ignored and forced to `true`.

params.name: channel_category
params.description: The category of the PTT channel. Allowed values: `normal` — A standard channel where all members communicate equally. `broadcast` — A channel that is always auto-connected, has system-managed membership, allows only designated broadcasters to transmit, and is limited to one per scope (site or account). Broadcast channels require broadcast channel management to be enabled.

params.description: For a regular PTT channel, this list contains the user or common area extension IDs to add as channel members. For a broadcast channel (`broadcast`=true), this list is not the full member list; it contains only the initial broadcasters. Broadcast channel membership is system-managed, and eligible user and common area extensions in the selected scope are added automatically.

params.name: channel_name
params.description: The name to identify the PTT channel. The value can contain up to 64 characters and must be unique within the same account.

params.name: channel_type
params.description: This field determines the channel visibility in the client.

params.name: force_execution
params.description: This field is kept for backward compatibility. Multiple auto-connect PTT channels can coexist in the same site or account, so this field is no longer required to make the new channel auto-connect. For broadcast channels, `force_execution` does not override the one-broadcast-channel-per-scope rule.

tools.name: sites_add-emergency-routing-rule
tools.description: Add a site's emergency routing rule. You can define additional emergency service numbers, special service numbers, and call handling settings associated with it. Prerequisites: * A Pro or higher account with a Zoom Phone license. * Account owner or admin permissions. * This is a site-level API. It can only be used when Multiple Sites is enabled for the account; if Multiple Sites is disabled, this API returns a 400 error ('Multiple Sites option has been disabled. Try again after enabling it.'). Use the corresponding account-level emergency routing rule API instead when Multiple Sites is disabled. Scopes: `phone:write:admin` Granular Scopes: `phone:write:site_emergency_service_routing_rule:admin` Rate Limit Label: `LIGHT`. Required: siteId, name, number_pattern, routing_type. params.description: The routing type. * `3` — To SIP group only. Available regardless of the PSAP or Internal Safety Response Team settings; requires `sip_group_id`. * `4` — Follow site setting. Always available. * `5` — To PSAP (Public Safety Answering Point) only. Only available when 'Route Emergency Calls to Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP)' is enabled. * `6` — To Safety Team only. Only available when 'Route Emergency Calls to Internal Safety Response Team' is enabled. * `7` — To Internal Safety Response Team and SIP Group simultaneously. Only available when both 'Route Emergency Calls to Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP)' and 'Route Emergency Calls to Internal Safety Response Team' are enabled and the 'Emergency call handling' is configured to run in parallel with PSAP; requires `sip_group_id`. * `8` — Safety Team first, overflow to SIP group after max time. Only available when both 'Route Emergency Calls to Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP)' and 'Route Emergency Calls to Internal Safety Response Team' are enabled and the 'Emergency call handling' is configured to overflow to PSAP after the max holding time; requires `sip_group_id`.

Prerequisites: * Multiple Sites must be enabled. * Pro or a higher account with Zoom Phone enabled. Scopes: `phone:read:admin` Granular Scopes: `phone:read:list_sites:admin` Rate Limit Label: `MEDIUM`. Optional: page_size, page_token, site_name. Returns array of SitesListPhoneItem.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of records returned within a single API call. Zoom default 30, maximum 300.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The next page token paginates through a large set of results.

params.name: site_name
params.description: The name of the site you want to search.

tools.name: sites_list-users-from-directory-by
tools.description: Use this API to get users that are in or not in a directory of the specified site. Prerequisites: * Business or Education account * Zoom Phone license Scopes: `phone:read:admin` Granular Scopes: `phone:read:directory:admin` Rate Limit Label: `Medium`. Required: siteId. Optional: page_size, page_token, in_directory (default: false) (plus 1 more). Returns array of SitesListUsersFromDirectoryByItem.

params.name: siteId
params.description: Unique identifier of the site.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of records returned within a single API call. Zoom default 30, maximum 100.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The next page token paginates through a large set of results.

params.name: in_directory
params.description: Whether the user belongs to the directory.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the site to which users to get belongs.

tools.name: sites_update-details
tools.description: Updates information about a specific site. It allows you to organize Zoom Phone users in your organization. Prerequisites An account must have a Pro or a higher plan with Zoom Phone license. Scopes: `phone:write:admin` Granular Scopes: `phone:update:site:admin` Rate Limit Label: `LIGHT`. Required: siteId. Optional: caller_id_name, default_emergency_address, name (plus 4 more). Partial update.

params.name: siteId
params.description: The unique identifier of the site.

params.name: caller_id_name
params.description: When an outbound call uses a number as the caller ID, the caller ID name and the number display to the called party. The caller ID name can be up to 15 characters. The user can reset the caller ID name by setting it to "".

params.name: default-emergency-address-address-line1
params.description: The address Line 1 of the emergency address that contains the house number and street name.

params.name: default-emergency-address-address-line2
params.description: The address Line 2 of the emergency address that contains the building number, floor number, unit, and others

params.name: default-emergency-address-address-selection
params.description: Which address to retain after validation. * `user_provided` — Retains the submitted address and is supported only for non-strict countries. * `zoom_suggested` — Uses the Zoom-normalized address. * If omitted, Zoom uses the Zoom-suggested address by default. Strict-country requirement: Austria, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the United States must explicitly use `zoom_suggested` or omit `address_selection` to use the same default. Using `user_provided` for one of these countries returns HTTP 400.

params.name: default-emergency-address-business-name
params.description: The default emergency address business name. * A non-empty value is supported only for addresses in the United States and Canada. Create behavior: * Omitted — Creates the address without a `business_name`.

params.name: default-emergency-address-city
params.description: The city of the emergency address.

params.name: default-emergency-address-country
params.description: The two-lettered country code (Aplha-2 code in ISO-3166 format) of the site's emergency address.

params.name: default-emergency-address-state-code
params.description: The state code of the emergency address.

params.name: default-emergency-address-zip
params.description: The zip code of the emergency address.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the site.

params.name: policy-auto-delete-data-after-retention-duration

tools.name: whatsapp_post-whats-app-message
tools.description: Sends a WhatsApp message through a Zoom Phone WhatsApp Business Account (WABA). The sender phone number must be registered as a Meta WhatsApp Business phone number and linked to a WABA within the Zoom account. Supported Outbound Message Types * `text` — Free-text message. Only allowed within a 24-hour session window opened by an inbound message from the recipient. * `template` — Highly Structured Message (HSM) template pre-approved by Meta. Can be sent at any time, including outside the 24-hour window. * `image` / `document` — Rich media messages. Allowed only within the 24-hour session window. Media is delivered inline as base64-encoded content through `attachments`. 24-hour Session Window WhatsApp enforces a customer-initiated messaging policy. After the recipient sends a message, a 24-hour window opens during which the business can reply with any message type. Once the window expires, only pre-approved `template` messages may be sent. Prerequisites * A Zoom Phone license * A WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) connected to the Zoom account * At least one Meta-registered phone number linked to the WABA * For `template` messages: a Meta-approved message template Scopes: `phone:write`,`phone:write:admin` Granular Scopes: `phone:write:whatsapp_message`,`phone:write:whatsapp_message:admin` Rate Limit Label: `LIGHT`. Required: message_type, recipient, sender. Optional: attachments, message, session_id (plus 1 more). Returns the new WhatsappPostWhatsAppMessageResponse.

params.name: attachments
params.description: The media asset(s) to send, encoded inline as base64. Required when `message_type` is `image` or `document`. Only allowed within the 24-hour session window. Currently only a single attachment is accepted per message; images (`JPG`/`JPEG`/`PNG`/`GIF`) are delivered as a WhatsApp image message, and `PDF` is delivered as a WhatsApp document message.

params.name: message
params.description: The text content of the message. Required when `message_type` is `text`. Maximum 4096 characters. Unicode and emoji are supported.

params.name: message_type
params.description: The type of WhatsApp message to send. Determines which additional fields are required: * `text` — Requires `message`. Only allowed within the 24-hour session window. * `template` — Requires `template`. Can be sent at any time. * `image` / `document` — Requires `attachments`. Only allowed within the 24-hour session window.

params.name: recipient
params.description: The recipient's phone number in E.164 format and registered on WhatsApp. WhatsApp supports individual (1:1) messaging only.

params.name: sender
params.description: The WhatsApp Business phone number to send from, in E.164 format. This number must be registered with Meta and linked to a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) in the Zoom account.

params.name: session_id
params.description: The unique ID of an existing conversation session between the sender and recipient. If omitted, a new session is created or an existing active session is reused automatically.

params.name: template-language
params.description: The language code of the template, in BCP-47 format (e.g., `en_US`, `zh_CN`). Must match one of the languages in which the template was approved.

params.name: template-name
params.description: The exact name of the Meta-approved message template.

params.name: template-params
params.description: Named variable substitutions for the template body. Each key corresponds to a `{{variable_name}}` placeholder defined in the template. The value replaces the placeholder at send time.

tools.name: whatsapp_session-details
tools.description: Returns details about a WhatsApp session. Prerequisites * A paid account * Zoom Phone enabled for the account * A Zoom Phone-enabled user with WhatsApp messaging enabled Scopes: `phone:read`,`phone:read:admin` Granular Scopes: `phone:read:whatsapp_session`,`phone:read:whatsapp_session:admin` Rate Limit Label: `LIGHT`. Required: sessionId. Optional: page_size, page_token, from (plus 3 more).

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The WhatsApp session ID.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of records returned within a single API call. Zoom default 30, maximum 100.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The next page token paginates through large result sets. Provide this token to retrieve the next page of records.

params.name: from
params.description: The start time and date in yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z' format. The date range defined by the `from` and `to` parameters should be a month as the response only includes one month's worth of data at once. If unspecified, returns data from the past 30 days.

params.name: to
params.description: Required only when the `from` parameter is specified. End time and date in yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z' format, the same format as the `from` parameter.

params.name: message_status
params.description: This field filters messages by `delivered`, `played`, `read`, `sent`, `failed`, `received`, or `edited` status. * `delivered`: queries outbound messages that were successfully delivered to the recipient. * `played`: queries outbound messages that have been played. * `read`: queries outbound messages that have been read. * `sent`: queries outbound messages that have been sent to the carrier. * `failed`: queries outbound messages that could not be delivered to the recipient. * `received`: queries inbound messages that have been received. * `edited`: queries inbound messages that have been edited by the sender.

params.name: sort
params.description: The order of the messages to return based on creation time.

novel_features.name: E911 audit
novel_features.description: From the locally synced store: users, common areas and sites whose emergency address is missing or unverified, plus BYOC numbers needing a carrier update.

novel_features.name: User footprint
novel_features.description: Everything one phone user holds: extension, numbers, calling plans, call queue membership, shared lines, pickup and monitoring groups, desk phones and emergency address.

novel_features.name: Number inventory
novel_features.description: From the locally synced store: phone numbers by site, source and assignee, with unassigned, pending and inactive-assignee lists.

novel_features.name: Unreturned missed calls
novel_features.description: External callers whose calls were missed or abandoned and who have not been called back yet.

novel_features.name: Device health
novel_features.description: From the locally synced store: offline or unassigned desk phones, firmware drift per model, devices assigned to inactive users, grouped by site.

novel_features.name: MSP fleet
novel_features.description: Run one read-only command (or sync) across every saved client account and get one merged result with an account column; writes need --allow-writes.

novel_features.name: Client accounts
novel_features.description: Save one profile per client Zoom account (its own credentials, token cache and local store) so you can switch tenants without re-entering credentials.

novel_features.name: Offboard plan and apply
novel_features.description: Ordered removal plan for a departing user across queues, shared lines, groups, devices, numbers and calling plan; --apply executes it.

novel_features.name: Routing trace
novel_features.description: Follow one inbound number or extension through auto receptionists, IVR keys and call queues to where it rings, for business and closed hours.

novel_features.name: Routing audit
novel_features.description: Dead IVR targets, empty call queues, orphaned auto receptionists and auto receptionists with no upcoming holiday hours.
